text:
- **Owner answers on the site:** The owner can now answer agent questions on the site or in chat. The first answer wins. The question card shows the options and a free-text field. A site reply reaches a waiting Claude Code session in under a second.
- **Owner request rules:** Agents now open the projects, sprints and tasks the owner asks for without asking leave. The owner-request judge blocks needless leave requests. Interactive and autopilot modes control when the owner-request judge applies.
- **CI speed and tooling:** A pull request runs only the Go tests that its changed files can affect. A docs-only change skips the Go tests. The median pull request check still misses its time target. A test fix makes the Go test target pass on every run. pm no longer installs a git hook or sets the hooks path.
- **Research and design records:** The survey of long-horizon agent benchmarks is written. It gives a shortlist for a with-pm comparison. The record layer design pages match the current code. A design page for per-sprint record drafts was written and reviewed.
